verdict.rationale: Unleash documents change requests that require an additional approval step before any change can be made in an environment [unleash-docs-11]. Environments explicitly model production stages [unleash-docs-10], so production flag changes can be gated behind approval, and the GitHub README lists change requests as a hosted-offering feature [unleash-gh-3]. Missing for 10: detail on approver configuration (number of approvals, who can approve, scheduling or applying approved changes), clarity on which plans include the feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
